parable.title: The Sower and the Seed
parable.content: A farmer went out to sow seed. As he scattered it, some fell along the path, some on rocky ground, some among thorns, and some on good soil, where it produced a crop.
parable.reflection: Where does the seed of God's word fall in your life?

parable.title: The Mustard Seed
parable.content: The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field. Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree.
parable.reflection: How has small faith grown into something greater in your life?

parable.title: The Growing Seed
parable.content: This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground. Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.
parable.reflection: What seeds have you planted that are growing beyond your understanding?

parable.title: The Vine and Branches
parable.content: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
parable.reflection: How do you remain in Christ to bear fruit?

parable.title: The Harvest
parable.content: The harvest is plentiful but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.
parable.reflection: How is God calling you to labor in His harvest field?

parable.title: The Good Samaritan
parable.content: A traveler beaten and left for dead is passed by, until a Samaritan stops, binds his wounds, and pays for his care.
parable.reflection: Who is your neighbor that God calls you to love with action?

parable.title: The Prodigal Son
parable.content: A son squanders his inheritance and returns in shame, but his father runs to meet him with a robe, a ring, and a feast.
parable.reflection: Where is the Father inviting you home — or inviting you to celebrate another's return?

parable.title: The Talents
parable.content: A master entrusts servants with talents before a journey; the faithful multiply them and hear 'well done,' while fear buries its portion.
parable.reflection: What talent has God entrusted to you that He wants multiplied?

parable.title: The Lost Sheep
parable.content: A shepherd leaves ninety-nine sheep to search for one that is lost, and heaven rejoices when it is found.
parable.reflection: Who is the one God is sending you to seek with patient love?

parable.title: The Leaven
parable.content: A woman hides a little leaven in a large batch of dough until the whole batch is leavened — so the kingdom quietly spreads.
parable.reflection: What small faithful influence is God multiplying through you unseen?

parable.title: The Pearl of Great Value
parable.content: A merchant seeking fine pearls finds one of surpassing worth and sells all he has to possess it.
parable.reflection: What is Christ worth to you — what would joyful surrender look like?

parable.title: The Lost Coin
parable.content: A woman loses a precious coin, lights a lamp, sweeps diligently until she finds it, and calls her friends to rejoice.
parable.reflection: What lost thing is worth your diligent searching — and who will you invite to rejoice?

parable.title: The Unforgiving Servant
parable.content: A servant forgiven an unpayable debt refuses to forgive a small one, and learns that forgiven people forgive.
parable.reflection: What debt are you holding that grace already cancelled?

parable.title: The Good Shepherd's Fold
parable.content: The shepherd enters by the door, calls his sheep by name, and lays down his life for them — and they know his voice.
parable.reflection: How do you recognize the Shepherd's voice among strangers?

parable.title: Salt and Light
parable.content: Disciples are the salt preserving the earth and the light that cannot be hidden — a city on a hill for all to see.
parable.reflection: Where has God placed you to preserve and to shine?

parable.title: The Fruit of the Spirit
parable.content: Those who walk by the Spirit bear a ninefold harvest — love, joy, peace, and more — against which there is no law.
parable.reflection: Which fruit of the Spirit is ripest in you, and which needs tending?

parable.title: The Armor of God
parable.content: Paul arrays believers for spiritual battle — truth, righteousness, peace, faith, salvation, the Word — and prayer on every occasion.
parable.reflection: Which piece of armor are you neglecting as you enter today's battle?

parable.title: The Shepherd's Psalm
parable.content: David sings the Shepherd who provides, restores, guides, protects, anoints, and pursues — goodness and mercy all our days.
parable.reflection: Which pasture of this psalm does your soul need most today?

parable.title: The New Creation
parable.content: In Christ the old passes away and the new has come — renewed minds, fresh mercies, and a spring in the desert.
parable.reflection: What old thing is Christ making new in you right now?

parable.title: The Towel and Basin
parable.content: On His last night, Jesus wraps a towel around Himself and washes His disciples' feet — the Master as servant.
parable.reflection: Whose feet is Christ asking you to wash this week?

modules.name: Cypress

parable.title: The Persistent Widow
parable.content: A widow's relentless pleas finally move an unjust judge — how much more will the just Father answer His children speedily?
parable.reflection: What have you stopped praying for that heaven still invites?

modules.unlock_message: Pray and do not lose heart...

parable.title: The Two Builders
parable.content: Two houses face the same storm: one founded on rock stands, one built on sand falls — hearing and doing makes the difference.
parable.reflection: What are you building on sand that needs moving to rock?

parable.title: The Great Commission
parable.content: The risen Christ claims all authority and sends His disciples to all nations — baptizing, teaching, and never leaving them.
parable.reflection: Who is your 'all nations' — and what is your next step of going?

modules.name: Brook

parable.title: The River of Life
parable.content: John sees a new heaven and new earth, God dwelling with His people, every tear wiped away — 'Behold, I make all things new.'
parable.reflection: How does the promised ending reshape your present persevering?

modules.unlock_message: Behold, He makes all things new...
